description: This file defines a PageWriter struct implementing buffered writing with page alignment, including methods for writing data and flushing buffers.

classes.name: PageWriter
classes.description: A struct that manages buffered, page-aligned writing to an io.Writer.

methods.name: NewPageWriter
methods.description: Constructor for PageWriter, initializes buffer and parameters.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the buffer, handling page alignment and flushing as needed.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to the underlying writer.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Internal method to perform the actual flush operation.
